course.title: Applied Statistics and Queuing Theory
course.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering

content.value: Ships arrive at a port at the rate of one in every 4 hours with exponential distribution of (14) [CO4] interarrival times. The time a ship occupies a berth for unloading has exponential distribution with an average of 10 hours. If the average delay of ships waiting for berth is to be kept below 14 hours, determine how many berths should be provided at the port.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
